perception.note: Darkvision, Lifesense 60ft precise, darkvision 60 feet, lifesense 60 feet (page 209)

defensiveAbilities.name: Dead Zone
defensiveAbilities.description: 30 feet. The area around a driftdead amalgam bristles with chaotic space torn from the Drift. The area is zero gravity. A creature that enters or begin its turn in the area take 4d6 Void Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw save).

defensiveAbilities.name: Torn from the Drift
defensiveAbilities.description: While outside the Drift, the amalgam gains the incorporeal trait, becomes immune to precision damage, and gains resistance 10 to all damage (except force, ghost killer, or spirit; double resistance vs. non-magical).

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Drift Ambush
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The driftdead teleports up to its Speed. If it's in the Drift, the distance a driftdead can teleport is doubled.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ripping Blast
offensiveAbilities.description: The amalgam's claws rip through reality in a 30ft Type:cone, dealing 8d6 Slashing Damage damage with a Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save. On a critical failure, a creature is also Drained 1. The amalgam can't use Ripping Blast again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Voice of the Damned
offensiveAbilities.description:
The amalgam calls out in a cacophony of voices from those slain in the Drift. Each living creature within 30 feet must attempt a DC 25 Will Saving Throw save.

Success The creature is temporarily immune to this amalgam's Voice of the Damned for 1 minute.

Failure The creature is Slowed 1 for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is slowed 1 for 2 rounds.
